newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Blue chips push Casablanca bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips push Casablanca bourse higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Tuesday 0.88 percent higher, led mainly by blue chips which are expected to publish good annual results, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 458.21 points from 454.21 points on Monday.

"Most stocks that increased in value especially in the banking sector and ONA goup and other leading firms ahead of their expected good audit sheets" Reda Mellakh, analyst at Casablanca Finance Intermediation said.
ONA group jumped 17 dirhams to close at 574 dirhams.
Wafabank, a liquid stock which recently merged with Spanish Uniban bank, was up seven dirhams to 565 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur was up four dirhams to 412 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose 7 dirhams to close at 322 dirhams.
Credit firm Eqdom Credit, which announced a capital increase recently, was up 23 dirhams to close at 808 dirhams.
Eqdom, Morocco's first consumer credit company, was set up in 1974 by holding company Societe Nationale d'Investissement and major insurance companies.
Brewery firm, Brasseries du Maroc, gained 43 dirhams to close at 1483 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 26.6 million dirhams from 22.1 million dirhams on Monday.
